Why go: a big sailing catamaran with a full crew

Kia Ora is a 54 ft sailing catamaran, one of the larger private yachts on Koh Samui, with a crew of six, a tender, a bar, a BBQ and an outdoor shower. Up to 15 guests pay one price and the boat can take 40, which makes it a good choice for celebrations that need space and service rather than speed.

What you'll do

The sunset sail leaves the north-east coast for Thongson Bay and Koh Som, with the sun setting behind Samui on the way back. Half days follow the north coast past Choeng Mon towards Koh Som with time to swim, snorkel and paddle board. The full day crosses to Koh Phangan for lunch ashore and an afternoon in the water before a sunset sail home.

Who it suits

  • Celebrations of 15–40 guests: birthdays, weddings and company events.
  • Families who want a steady boat with shade, a shower and a toilet.
  • Anyone prone to seasickness: a large catamaran is far steadier than a speedboat.

Who should choose something else

  • Couples and small groups: Nina or Kindred Spirit cost about half.
  • Groups who want to cover distance to Koh Tao or Ang Thong in a day: a private speedboat is faster.

Good to know

  • Wind: sails go up when there is enough wind; on calm days the crew motors at about 7 knots.
  • Food: order catering in advance so the crew can stock the boat.
  • Rain: October to December brings showers; the covered deck keeps guests dry.

Before you book

Choose the sunset, half day or full day and tell us your group size and any catering wishes. For groups above 15 we add the extra-guest charge, and for parties we can arrange a van for every 10 guests.
